UP Police Computer Operator Syllabus / Exam Pattern 2025

Post Date: September 17, 2025

12:30 pm

Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment & Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has published the updated UP Police Computer Operator Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2025, along with the exam schedule. Applicants should carefully go through the revised syllabus, marking scheme, and subject-wise topics before starting their preparation. The selection process for the UP Police Computer Operator posts will be carried out in four stages: Written Examination, Documentation & Physical Standard Test (PST), Stenography Test, and Medical & Personality Test.
